field.label: Set shaper bandwidth
field.help: Allow the "speedtest setshaper" action (cron job or Apply now) to set the bandwidth of the traffic shaper pipes from the speedtest results.

field.label: Interface
field.help: Interface the speedtest runs over. Its enabled shaper rules point to the pipes to update: incoming traffic to the download pipe, outgoing traffic to the upload pipe. Without rules on this interface, the pipes named WAN_download_p and WAN_upload_p are used.

field.label: Threshold (%)
field.help: Pipe bandwidth as a percentage of the average speedtest result, for download and upload.

field.label: Speedtest probes
field.help: Number of most recent speedtest results to average.

field.label: Minimum change (%)
field.help: Only update a pipe when the new bandwidth differs from the current one by at least this percentage.
